title: It's my birthday, wanted to share something I've been building
author: Ok_Pay_6957
selftext:
Hey, today's my birthday and I wanted to celebrate by documenting something I've been building for the past 2 months. I've been trading futures for 3 years. Passed evals, secured payouts, understand the game.

  
About two months ago I had a realization: I already had the edge. What I needed was to build a system around it. I knew AI had become powerful enough that I could automate what I already knew, build something that lives and trades in real time, and then use that same AI to analyze the live data and refine the strategy over time. That became ALA — Autonomous Learning Algorithm.  
The first month was rough. I live-logged 17 trades, built a dashboard to capture everything, and fed the full trade log into a Hermes AI analysis agent. It instantly produced a structured report; flagged the dominant loss pattern, identified what was working, what wasn't. Counter-trend entries against a declining EMA were killing the longs. I implemented the recommended filters. The results flipped completely. Here are the results! Just ran the first fully automated session yesterday! Long way to go but the foundation feels solid.

  
Going to keep posting updates as the journey continues. Check my profile if you want to follow along

replies.author: LiveBeyondNow
replies.body: Sort of.  My point was, in some instances, a Sharpe of 0.5 is very good. S&P has a roughly same Sharpe. If the OP’s strategy has a lower drawdown (than S&P 55%), then it can be leveraged giving considerable alpha. Point is, Sharpe alone says very little so your point is mute.

comments.author: LiveBeyondNow
comments.body: Nice work. Would be interested to know more.  What did Hermes have? Just trade logs? Or did it have OHLCV data to interrogate? I’m curious on any basic implementation details you can share, especially around Hermes.

replies.author: Ok_Pay_6957
replies.body: Hey! so basically I created my own pine script and custom dashboard running on a VPS, and livelogged each individual trade daily automatically with screenshots of before and after. After about 17 trades, I added Hermes to the VPS. Hermes analyzed all the data I had gathered up until that point and gave me a full report and what was/wasn't working. Then I fed that data back to Claude to tweak the original pine script to get these results. Hope this helps!
